derivation: Late-game tier (KERNE-SELTENHEIT 5.3): the Strong Upgrade costs a nether star, so only the template is sold, rarely, by the wandering trader; the Strong Beacon and Strong Conduit stay crafted (each needs a second nether star).

excluded.simplebeacons:strong_beacon: Needs a beacon and a nether star on top of the template; a trade would skip the boss.
excluded.simplebeacons:strong_conduit: Needs a conduit and a nether star on top of the template; a trade would skip the boss.
excluded.simplebeacons:guide_book: Crafted from a book and a prismarine shard.
